english: Excuse me!\nI've brought my\n[blue]Dango Shop[/color] ticket stub.
...Tell the [blue]Dango Shop[/color] too.\nGin Tama are nice,\nbut the real stuff's better.
Of course.\nIt's a joint promotion\nwith the [blue]Dango Shop[/color].
The [blue]Dango Shop[/color] and I\nfigured only Gin Tama\nwould win customers now.
Hey, Shinpachi. Come on. Calm down a little.
Saw Otsu, the idol, earlier. She really IS cute...

I'm not hiding anything!
Don't make me sound bad!
Let's see... Oh, right!
[blue]North Golden St.[/color]
Oh? Did you meet Otsu?\n...Not yet, huh?\fI saw her on [blue]North Golden St.[/color]\nDon't forget.
Found Otsu? Oh, good.\fIdols have it rough. Chased by stalk... I mean, devoted fans like you!\fGlad I'm just an ordinary girl!
How am I meant to calm down?!
[blue]North Golden St.[/color], right?!\nYou'd better not be lying!
By the way, Captain! Saw Otsu earlier.
Oh, Captain!\nFound Otsu yet?\n[blue]North Golden St.[/color]
Oh, it's the Otsu fan-club... Good work today.
Fool! Be precise\nand give details!\nWhere did you see her?
I know. Quit worrying about me!
Thanks for the report.\nKeep up the good work\nsupporting Otsu!

Saw that idol, Otsu,
on [blue]North Golden St.[/color]
a little while ago. Cute girl.
Still no match for me.
Oh, looks like you found her. That Otsu girl...
I said STOP, Shinpachi! Come on!
Don't make me repeat myself! The likes of YOU...!
Hey, I saw Otsu\non [blue]North Golden St.[/color]\nearlier.
Ugh! You... Um, d-did you find Otsu...?
[blue]North Golden St.[/color]\nS-s-she must still be there!\nG-good luck...
Oh, h-hello... Looks like you found Otsu...
...No. Even Zura would probably pass on that.
Still at it, Shinpachi?! Zura is NOT handsome!
Found him? A peerless beauty, wasn't he?\fAhh... If only I were twenty years younger...
Oh, you again?\nDid you meet that handsome\nman on [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color]?
Don't be stupid! Zura's NOT handsome!
Saw a very handsome man\nnear [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color].
Those long, narrow eyes... Couldn't resist...

See, Gin? [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color].
Let's go check. If it's Katsura,
we have questions.
About Gin Tama...
Quit the nonsense! I'll knock you flat!
Haven't seen him. Don't even KNOW anyone named Zura...
[blue]Saguri Bridge[/color]?\nWhat's Katsura doing\nin a place like that?
Trying so hard... But we've questions about Gin Tama too.\fLet's go see him.
Let's leave it at that, then.
Hmm. If I feel like it.
I SAID, if I feel like it!
Didn't want to see him, anyway.
Me? Back from a delivery... Saw Katsura over there. Got talking.
If you see him again, tell him to drop by my shop.
Shall we go, Gin? Want to ask about Gin Tama.
Let's go see him. Come on, Gin?
You DO care. Just won't admit it...
Hmph. If I feel like it.
Hmph. Don't even WANT to see that Zura.
Really? Thought you were off to see him now.
...I suppose\nI can tell you.\nHe's near [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color].
Katsura was near\n[blue]Saguri Bridge[/color].\nYou may still catch him.
Found Katsura, then. Get to talk?
Let's go, Gin. Got questions for Katsura. About Gin Tama, for one...
Something's wrong. Not a scrap of his usual wasted energy!
Can't be bothered... Actually, I'm quitting the fan club...
No... Quitting's too much trouble too...
Ahh... Whatever. Don't care about anything...
What's this pathetic state?! You're meant to be Otsu's...!
Even feeling lazy is too much effort...
Not my problem! Do what you like!
Even if you say that... Doing what I like is too much trouble...
Weird... Night's meant to be my favorite. Don't feel like anything...
Done being a playboy. Too much trouble...
Too much trouble. Disband the organization... No, wait. That's trouble too...\f...Forget it. Go with the flow.
True, but... This... Something's definitely wrong.
Kids should stay quietly at home!
But playing's too much trouble too... What to do...
Too much trouble to go HOME...?!
Too lazy to play? You're a KID!
Just becomes a wall or fence.
Ahh, too much trouble... I quit!
What the hell is going on?!
Oh... You lot.\nFull of energy, huh...
Oh, that's right.\nI was looking for\nthat curly mop.
Gin! No time\nto go drinking\nfor free!
Kids should stay quietly at home!
But playing's too much trouble too... What to do...
Too much trouble to go HOME...?!
Too lazy to play? You're a KID!
